name: scored-run-nojump
description: CP4 adversarial probe (T-016, B.1 fall-loop/toothlessness check): default run, ?score=1&fallback=1, hold right + fire and NEVER jump. Every gap and wasp becomes a setback. What this measures: consecutive un-recovered fallbacks must cross the streak ceiling into the stock lives tier (a terminal state exists — no free fall loop), the fallback catch-ahead must not out-progress the competent scored-run script (dying must not be a shortcut), and CHARGE must sit at the floor for a policy that never moves through the air.
